# Stake WBTC

> Stake WBTC is a non-custodial interface for depositing WBTC, the ERC-20 wrapper of Bitcoin on Ethereum, into protocols that pay for it. WBTC has no native staking, so the page explains the options: lending, liquidity pools and restaking vaults. Users connect their own wallet and sign every transaction.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- WBTC is an ERC-20 token on Ethereum that represents BTC and has no native staking.
- Staking WBTC means depositing it into lending markets, liquidity pools or vaults that accept it.
- Lending yield comes from borrower interest; pools earn fees and face impermanent loss; restaking vaults add rewards and extra risk.
- WBTC uses 8 decimals, needs a one-time ERC-20 approval and gas is paid in ETH.
- The interface is non-custodial: the user signs every transaction and it never holds funds or keys.

## Pages

- Stake WBTC & learn: https://stake-wbtc.github.io/
- Legal: https://stake-wbtc.github.io/legal.html
